verdict.rationale: replica-skill is a set of Claude skills that you drive from inside an AI chat. You invoke slash commands such as /replica-backend, you can paste a SKILL.md into any chat so it "runs as a mode", and the deploy step "ships it when you say go". That makes conversational operation part of the product's own design, but the main documented interface is slash commands rather than free-form natural-language commands. missing for 10: explicit documentation of free-form natural-language instructions beyond slash commands, examples of conversational steering of each skill, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Paste any single `SKILL.md` at the top of a chat and it runs as a mode.
ships it when you say go
/replica-backend adds sign up, Google Calendar through Google's own API with your keys, Stripe for paid bookings, reminder emails.
